data.description:
## Description

**What**: Create `plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh` that provisions the telemetry S3 bucket with lifecycle rule (90d → Glacier Instant Retrieval), public-access-block, server-side encryption, and bucket policy denying non-Lambda writes. The script must be re-runnable as a no-op and must write `review_telemetry.bucket_name` back to `.claude/dso-config.conf`.
**Why**: This is the walking-skeleton foundation — every downstream story (Lambda handler, emit utility, query-stats) reads `bucket_name` from config. Without idempotent provisioning we cannot re-deploy, and without the config-key write we cannot wire the 7-command live verification in sc-10.
**Scope**:
- IN: S3 bucket creation, lifecycle rule (90d → Glacier IR), public-access-block, SSE, bucket policy denying non-Lambda PutObject, IAM permission pre-flight check, `review_telemetry.bucket_name` config-key write.
- OUT: Lambda function, IAM execution role (draft-2), handler code (separate story), aws-status.sh (separate story).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, running `aws-setup-bucket.sh` against a configured AWS account creates an S3 bucket with public access blocked, server-side encryption enabled, and a lifecycle rule transitioning objects older than 90 days to Glacier Instant Retrieval.
  ← Satisfies: sc-1  (sc-1: "S3 bucket with lifecycle rule 90d → Glacier IR, public access blocked, idempotent setup")
- When this story is complete, re-running `aws-setup-bucket.sh` after a successful first run reports no resource changes (idempotent no-op).
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, `.claude/dso-config.conf` contains a `review_telemetry.bucket_name=<bucket>` line with the provisioned bucket name after `aws-setup-bucket.sh` succeeds.
  ← Satisfies: sc-10  (sc-10: "resource names written to dso-config.conf by aws-setup-*.sh scripts")
- When this story is complete, the bucket policy denies PutObject from any principal other than the Lambda execution role identified in dso-config.conf.
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, missing IAM permissions for the operator running the script produce a clear pre-flight error message before any AWS resource is created.
  ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Security] Public-access-block must be set before any object writes can land; ordering matters.
- [Idempotency] Use `head-bucket` style checks rather than `create-bucket` retries — re-running must not return non-zero on a healthy bucket.
- [Region] AWS region pinned to us-east-1 per epic scope; document this in the script comments.
- [Config write] Use a config-write helper that preserves existing keys and rewrites only the `review_telemetry.bucket_name` line.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an operator, I want aws-setup-bucket.sh to provision the telemetry S3 bucket idempotently and write its name to dso-config.conf, so that downstream verification and the Lambda handler can locate the bucket by config key.
